THE EXPEDITION HANDBOOK

Listen. Light. Leave.

Three relays have gone silent. Wake them, then return to the orange camp beacon to send your rescue signal.

01 / FIND YOUR WAY

Follow the fireflies.

Press Q to send a resonance pulse. A stream of amber fireflies leads toward your selected relay. Press M to choose a destination.

02 / BRING BACK THE LIGHT

Wake the old relays.

Stand close and hold E for three seconds. Tuning costs 20 resonance. An awakened relay becomes a safe shelter and recharges your equipment.

03 / WATCH WHAT FOLLOWS

The storm hears you.

Pulsing and sprinting stir the red storm wisps. Keep your distance, or press F to drop an echo lure. It draws them away for 18 seconds.

04 / STAY IN THE WILD

A little light goes a long way.

Gather luminous blue flowers with E for vitality, resonance, and another lure. Your resonance slowly recharges by itself.

WASD MoveShift SprintSpace JumpEsc PauseP Photo view

Mouse looks around. If mouse capture is unavailable, hold and drag to look. Touch controls appear on phones and tablets. Wander mode has no deadline or damage.

ABOUT THIS WORLD

Made for the wild.

Wildsignal is an original browser expedition inspired by the dense wilderness of Electric Dreams.

It uses its own terrain, gameplay and world layout, with CC0 scanned materials and plants from Poly Haven and the Three.js renderer.

The Unreal Engine Electric Dreams project and its UE-only assets are not included. This is a compact browser world, not the original 4 × 4 km environment.
